anti_rescue_rule: After any external advisory or event-time source response is observed, no source repo, snapshot rule, event window, candidate cap, eligibility rule, graph parser, threshold, baseline, or verdict rule may change in SLD-003.
anti_tautology: Positive verdict is not earned merely because advisory publication precedes remediation. It requires preregistered transitive incremental coverage, stale-watchlist precision advantage, ecosystem diversity, and remediation lead as a secondary condition.
claim: In real dependency histories, exact-state full-graph standing detects materially more advisory invalidations than direct-dependency watching because consequential events occur at transitive depth, while event-time rebinding suppresses stale snapshot alerts; detected standing loss can precede downstream remediation.
direct_baseline: alerts only when the affected event-time package has dependency depth 1
headline: first later lockfile commit by remediation_horizon at which the advisory no longer affects any reachable version of the target package
stale_snapshot_baseline: alerts on every retained advisory matched to the frozen 2025-01-01 snapshot, without event-time rebinding
standing_loss_time: OSV advisory published timestamp after event-time affected-version confirmation
